notes: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them (via Exophase, cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements). Hidden flags are as the list marks them: 28 hidden, 27 visible. Every guide below is written in our own words for this guide; each cites the published source its facts come from. Where no published guide has pinned a trigger down yet, the guide says so instead of guessing.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum has no task of its own: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. Work the roadmap in order, leave the 100% checklist gold for last, and this is the trophy that closes the set. No multiplayer or DLC is needed for it.
steps: Finish the story and every stranger strand.
Clear the 100% completion checklist (A Long Road).
Mop up the miscellaneous trophies in stage 6; the platinum pops with the last one.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: This is the opening mission, Gone Fishing, so it unlocks naturally at the start of the game. Just play through the intro until the mission ends and the trophy pops. Nothing here can be missed.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Follow the on-screen objectives until the mission completes.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies (official list via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. The story runs five chapters and takes roughly 60 to 80 hours in total, so this is the first of several chapter trophies. Before the chapter ends, do the one missable meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude).
steps: Play through all Chapter 1 missions.
Do the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house before the chapter ends.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

Pick up stranger strands and side missions as they appear.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies (official list via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

steps: Play through all Chapter 3 missions.
Scan vehicles and study animals along the way; the progress counts early.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies (official list via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

There is no mission replay in this game, so keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter — the game gives 15 manual save slots plus one autosave — in case you want a safety net before the finale.
steps: Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 4.
Play through all Chapter 4 missions.
Make another manual save once the chapter closes.

After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see the checklist.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the one the whole roadmap builds toward. The 100% checklist only becomes visible after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts. The thresholds are lenient — PowerPyx puts the checklist at roughly 60% of true completion: you need 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied through the binoculars, and 70 of 80 challenges, so you can skip the hardest ones. Only a few categories demand everything: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Nothing on the checklist is permanently missable, so it can all be finished in free roam after the credits.
steps: Finish the story to reveal the checklist under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Work the checklist section by section; most of it overlaps with other trophies.
Scan 200 of 277 vehicles and study 100 of 255 animals through the binoculars.
Complete 70 of the 80 challenges, skipping the hardest ones.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies (official list via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 stunts across Leonida. PowerPyx counts 397 stunts in total — stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife-edge flights and base jumps — so you do not need all of them. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so keep going past 250 while you are out in free roam and this trophy will fall out of the same grind.
steps: Attempt stunt jumps, bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps as you travel.
Track progress in the Progress menu; any 250 count.
Keep going to 300 stunts for the 100% checklist.

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophies and Achievements Guide

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type in the game at least once — nine types in total, from races and fishing to the arcade and the shooting range. You only need to try each one, not win or finish it, so this is a quick tour rather than a grind. Do it during the story whenever an activity appears, and the last one pops the trophy.
steps: Try each activity type once as you meet it: races, fishing, arcade games, shooting range, drone races, bowling, meditation and the rest.
You only need to try them, not win.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies (official list via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The ranges are also one of the few categories the 100% checklist demands in full, so golding them all does double duty. Take them one weapon at a time, learn each challenge's scoring, and replay any that fall short — the gold thresholds are demanding but, by PowerPyx's account, not brutal.
steps: Visit the shooting ranges and work through the 42 challenges.
Replay any challenge below gold until it medals gold.
Gold in all 42 pops the trophy and clears the checklist category.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies (official list via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone races are also required in full by the 100% checklist, so winning them all serves both trophies. Learn each course's corners, cut them tight, and retry any location you lose — a win at every spot is what counts, not a single perfect run.
steps: Find the Top Fun drone races across Leonida (14 locations).
Win a race at each location.
Retry any location until you have a win everywhere.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies (official list via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different is the key word: the same race won twice counts once, so spread your wins across the map — road races, off-road, boat and air events all count as long as each race is a new one. Pick fast, well-handling vehicles and retry any race you lose.
steps: Enter races across Leonida and win them.
Keep to new races — repeats do not add to the count.
20 different wins pops the trophy.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies (official list via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head contests of weight and patience: cast well, work the line without snapping it, and land the bigger catch. If you lose, challenge him again — the trophy only needs one win.
steps: Take up a fishing challenge against Cal.
Land the better catch to beat him.
Retry the challenge if you lose; one win is enough.

Play a game through to its end.

Complete three more stranger strands anywhere in Leonida.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY — protect it early. There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations, and meditating at a spot as both Jason and Lucia counts twice. The catch is the very first one: during Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning and she will offer to meditate on the balcony at Jason's house. Follow her, accept, and do it — that session becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1, and it is unconfirmed whether it counts toward the trophy, so doing it is the safe choice. The 100% checklist only asks for 15 of 18 meditations, so the checklist itself is safe either way. Track your count under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
steps: CHAPTER 1 — after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and meditate. Do not leave this for later.
Meditate at the other spots across Leonida; doing a spot as both Jason and Lucia counts twice.
Check Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations until all 18 are done.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's quests are one of the few categories the 100% checklist demands in full, so his strand is worth doing properly rather than rushing. Follow Bret's missions until he sends you after the unique animal, then track and take it down.
steps: Pick up Bret's missions when they appear.
Follow his strand until he asks you to hunt the unique animal.
Track it down and complete the hunt.

steps: Collect cards as you explore Leonida.
Finish one full set, then a second and a third.
Three completed sets pops the trophy.

Sweep the map area by area; 100 different locations count.
Pair it with exploring Leonida for The Goodtime State.

trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape. Build the wanted level up to four stars with your partner alongside, then break line of sight — duck into alleys, switch vehicles, hide until the stars fade. The trophy pops once the heat is fully gone and you are both clear.
steps: Have your partner with you and raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Break line of sight and hide until the wanted level clears.
Escape with your partner to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in a row with your partner while keeping your wanted level alive the whole time. The trick is the opposite of most robberies: do not let the heat die between shops. Pick three shops close together, move fast between them, and keep the wanted level up until the third robbery is done.
steps: Bring your partner and rob a shop to raise your wanted level.
Move straight to a second shop, then a third, without losing the wanted level.
Three back-to-back robberies with the heat intact pops the trophy.

steps: Discover new vehicles as you explore; each new one counts.
Aim for variety across cars, bikes, boats and aircraft.
100 discoveries pops the trophy; keep going to 200 for the 100% checklist.

Set it up where enemies bunch together — a gang shootout or a wanted-level standoff — then trigger Combat Focus and chain five takedowns before it ends. If you fall short, let the meter refill and try again at the next crowded fight.
steps: Find a fight with five or more enemies close together.
Trigger Combat Focus and take down five of them in that one use.

Try departing by aircraft outside a scheduled flight.

steps: Pick a jewelry store and case its guards and cameras.
Rob it without being seen; leave before any alarm.
If detected, escape and retry.

Repeat until five vaults are robbed and escaped from.

Take the cash, then escape the police response.

This pairs well with the WAiNK It and vehicle-discovery trophies, since all three reward the same travelling.
steps: Travel across Leonida and visit every area; the map tracks visited ones.
Check the map for areas you have never entered and sweep them last.
All 52 areas visited pops the trophy.

steps: Find illegal operations run by the gangs.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Track which gangs are done; one per gang is enough.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies — bank vaults, armored trucks and gang operations — and your contacts turn them into clean cash. Keep robbing and laundering through the story and the cleanup, and the total adds up on its own.
steps: Rob bank vaults, armored trucks and gang operations to collect marked bills.
Launder the bills through your contacts.
$250,000 laundered pops the trophy.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies (official list via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Weapons, clothes, vehicles and upgrades all count, so this climbs naturally as you gear up through the game. If you reach the endgame short of the total, the fastest top-up is buying the most expensive gear you still want — it is spending you would do anyway.
steps: Spend money in shops as you play: weapons, clothes, vehicles, upgrades.
Track the total in the Progress menu.
$100,000 spent pops the trophy.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies (official list via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages appear for sale as you explore and earn money; each one you buy adds to the count, and the trophy pops with the eighth. Save up through the story — the laundering and robbery money from Dime on the Dollar helps — and buy garages as they come on the market.
steps: Find garage properties for sale across Leonida.
Buy them as you can afford them; 8 in total.
The eighth purchase pops the trophy.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies (official list via Exophase / PSNProfiles)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you find a vehicle worth keeping, open the app and register it — the count grows one vehicle at a time. It pairs with discovering vehicles for Whip It Good, so register the interesting ones as you find them.
steps: Find a vehicle and open the Scooter Bros app.
Register the vehicle to the app.
10 registered vehicles pops the trophy.
